# UNESCO-UNEVOC International Centre

> > The UNESCO-UNEVOC International Centre serves as the global hub for Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET), connecting over 260 institutions worldwide to advance skills development and lifelong learning.

UNESCO-UNEVOC operates as a specialized centre under UNESCO's mandate, coordinating the UNEVOC Network to strengthen TVET systems globally. The centre focuses on bridging innovation and learning through initiatives like BILT, the TVET Leadership Programme, and the i-hubs project, while promoting greening of TVET and digital transformation to support the Sustainable Development Goals.
